source.name: Yotsuba Society Archives, part 2 (2016-12-04)
source.short-desc: Yotsuba Society thread archives, single 83GB tarball dated 2016-12-04.
source.capture: 4chan JSON API thread dumps nested under a 4chan/ prefix: 4chan/<board>/<threadno>/<threadno>.json. The extra level is stripped when staging so the adapter sees <board>/<threadno>/.

prepare.name: untar the archive (83GB, slow)
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && for f in source/*.tar.gz; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; tar xzf "$f" -C extracted; done

prepare.name: stage the thread tree for ingest (dropping the 4chan/ prefix)
prepare.run: rm -rf out && src=extracted && [ -d extracted/4chan ] && src=extracted/4chan; (cp -al "$src" out 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$src" out)

prepare.name: convert the thread dumps to out-ndjson/<board>/posts.ndjson
